process: The author works hard and inventively on goal 8 (radical ideas: depth-model terrain, papercraft, a measured 'did they miss me') and goal 5 (Lumi's own life and pages). The mini games got real attention in s104: berries nearer, fireflies within reach, the moth out of races, and it shows in play. But four sessions of new ideas went into things a player sees only through a caption, and the items that change every frame (materials #479, light #237, the G flight #516, the jump-in camera #518) moved little since s103. Goals 4 and 7 (rendering, tracer-only materials) are the furthest behind: no new material or real light in any s106 film. Goal 6 is half there: films are clean except frame-2 pops, but the player's own flight is still a standing Lumi in the sky. Goal 3 (physics) is idle. Goal 2 has releases but nothing at golden hour. The next sessions should make one of the new ideas look as good as it sounds (the ghosts as glass, the hill as a readable face, a flight that flies) rather than add a fifth idea.

animation.why: live_motion: 8 of 10 moving well. Wibbles turns 61° in one frame and a foot jumps 0.22 m (6.6 m/s); Hopscotch's claw judders. After G in jump-in, Lumi stayed :idle for ~4 s, then hung 8-10 m up in :gasp/:scared poses with its legs straight down (log: 'action scared z 8.67'). Every film jumps on frame 2 (missme 0.138, cloud-watching 0.067), and missme pops a pig and a sheep into the foreground at 7.71 s (0.152).

camera.why: Mini game chase views are good (pitch ≤ 27°, the target ahead). In jump-in (follow), the G flight leaves the frame on empty sea with Lumi out of view, and twice the cottage stands in front of Lumi (jump-sheet-follow.png, row 2 frame 4 and row 3 frame 4). With 'Camera: orbit' picked, jump-in stays a 13 m, 32° map view where Lumi is a speck (jump-sheet.png). The missme film's payoff is shot from behind the pig and the blob.

creatures.why: The faces are good: Gloop's eyes, the crab, the hatted pigs, the little chick that follows Lumi in mini games. The 'yesterday' ghosts are faceless flat white silhouettes and show in half the close-ups.

fun.why: Played: all three mini games have a goal you understand at once, keys that answer, a clock, an end card with a new best and level 2 ('quicker fireflies', 'critters hurry sooner'), and a reward that lands on the island (fireflies to the lantern, berries to the basket). That is a real reason to play twice. Level 1 is too easy: a W-and-turn bot wins every game with half the time left. Jump-in's keys mostly do something (sneeze, hiccup, paint splats that stay, a rewind with scanlines). G's flight is the weak one: 4 s of nothing, then a lost camera. There is still no fourth game, and four sessions added things to watch, not to play.

lighting.why: The 08:00 follow view has a good low light (long shadows over the beach), and night is a readable blue grey with lit windows. At 18:38 dozens of flat, unshaded orange discs up to 80 px wide float in front of the lens (dusk-follow*.png). All three s106 films and every post still are late morning. No traced picture has a real point or area light that lights its surroundings.

materials.why: Unchanged since s103. In missme.mp4, face-hill.mp4, cloud-watching.mp4 and the new stills, pig, blob, board, workbench and hill are diffuse or plastic. The 'yesterday' ghosts are flat, unshaded white cut-outs (creatures.png), and the paper Lumi stands on a plain white card. Only the sea and the pond's glass read as real materials.

performance.why: Sandbox frame 3.6 ms median, 6.3 ms p95, and 30 fps through four minutes of driven mini games.

props.why: Plenty of generated assets used well (cottage, swing, workbench, toadstools, easels). The missme board's text is mirrored from behind (jump-sheet-follow.png, row 2: '(nim 2) EM TUOHTIW'), and it stands in the middle of the island. Clutter grows: easels, a giant top hat and crates fill the follow views' foreground (follow2.png). The paper Lumi's legs are two navy sticks.

style.why: The clay toy look holds for the assets. On top of it come four other visual languages: flat white ghosts, flat orange dusk coins, an ochre depth-hill, and a low-poly faceted paper Lumi. More and more of the frame is the same saturated yellow (the hill, Lumi, the giant, flower fields).

ui.why: The mini game cards and HUD lines are clear. With the pointer on the controls bar (where Play and Stop are), the browser moth sits in front of the 3D view as a big white blur in every mini game shot (games-sheet.png, bottom-left of each frame). Lumi's long speech runs off the left edge in orbit (orbit.png), and hearts cover the name labels (follow-morning2.png).

world.why: Since s103 (progress-overview.jpg, 4 panels: s20/s103/s105/s106) the overview gained the yellow face hill and yellow haze behind the cottage. Eye level gained a pale path of pebble-word stones and a giant yellow Lumi over the left third (progress-eye-level.jpg). Compared with s20 it is a different island: dense, varied, coloured. But the newest additions make the frame busier and yellower, not clearer. The face hill reads as a lumpy ochre mound from above (site/img/face-hill.png).

wow.why: The ideas are radical (a depth model raising the meadow, papercraft of yourself, a measured 'they missed me'), but the pictures don't deliver them. The hill doesn't read as a face, and the missme film ends on Lumi's back behind a pig with the numbers unreadable at 960x540. A stranger would need the caption to get any of it.

summary: The three mini games are the island's solid core. Played for a minute each through interact!, a W/A/D steer won every one on a first try (fireflies 8/8 in 44 s, berries 10 to 4, hide and seek 4/4 in 40 s), with clear start cards, a HUD that points the way and level-up end cards. Everything around them is weaker. Jump-in's G flight leaves Lumi standing or 'scared' 8-10 m up while the camera looks at empty sea, the new missme board reads mirrored from behind, and the face hill reads as an ochre blob from every camera. Next to session 103 the island is more crowded and more yellow, but not better lit and not in better materials: still the same plastic under one sun.
